"import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc
import json

# ===============================================================
# Simple Turbojet - DESIGN point (SL, MN ~ 0)
# Targets:  Fn_target = 10000 lbf,  T4_target = 2300 degR, OPR = 12.0
# Components: Inlet + Compressor(AXI5) + Combustor +
#             Turbine(LPT2269) + Nozzle + Shaft
# Thermo: TABULAR / AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC (pycycle default)
# ===============================================================

prob = om.Problem()

# ----- Top-level independent (design) variables -----
des_vars = prob.model.add_subsystem('des_vars', om.IndepVarComp())

des_vars.add_output('alt',          0.0,    units='ft')
des_vars.add_output('MN',           0.0)
des_vars.add_output('Fn_des',       10000.0, units='lbf')
des_vars.add_output('T4_des',       2300.0,  units='degR')
des_vars.add_output('OPR',          12.0)
des_vars.add_output('ram_recovery', 1.0)
des_vars.add_output('comp_eff',     0.9)
des_vars.add_output('turb_eff',     0.9)
des_vars.add_output('Cv',           0.99)

# ----- Build the cycle -----
cycle = prob.model.add_subsystem('cycle', om.Group())

# Thermodynamic tables - default is AIR_JETA (TABULAR with AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC)
thermo_kwargs = {'thermo_data': pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC, 'thermo_method': 'TABULAR'}

cycle.add_subsystem('fc',    pyc.FlightConditions())
cycle.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet())
cycle.add_subsystem('comp',  pyc.Compressor(map_data=pyc.AXI5,    design=True))
cycle.add_subsystem('comb',  pyc.Combustor())
cycle.add_subsystem('turb',  pyc.Turbine(map_data=pyc.LPT2269,    design=True))
cycle.add_subsystem('nozz',  pyc.Nozzle())                          # CD nozzle
cycle.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft())
cycle.add_subsystem('perf',  pyc.Performance())

# ----- Drive top-level variables into components -----
prob.model.connect('des_vars.alt',          'cycle.fc.alt')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.MN',           'cycle.fc.MN')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.ram_recovery', 'cycle.inlet.ram_recovery')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.comp_eff',     'cycle.comp.eff')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.turb_eff',     'cycle.turb.eff')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.Cv',           'cycle.nozz.Cv')
prob.model.connect('des_vars.OPR',          'cycle.comp.PR')

# ----- Flow-station connections (P, T, W) -----
for src, dst in [('fc', 'inlet'), ('inlet', 'comp'),
                 ('comp', 'comb'), ('comb', 'turb'),
                 ('turb', 'nozz')]:
    for var in ('P', 'T', 'W'):
        cycle.connect(f'{src}.Fl_O:tot:{var}', f'{dst}.Fl_I:tot:{var}')

# ----- Shaft ties compressor and turbine torques -----
cycle.connect('comp.trq', 'shaft.trq_in')
cycle.connect('turb.trq', 'shaft.trq_out')

# ----- Performance: inlet air flow & jet exit velocity -----
cycle.connect('inlet.Fl_O',         'perf.Fl_in')     # W_air, inlet conditions
cycle.connect('nozz.Fl_O:stat:V',   'perf.V_jet')     # exit velocity

# ----- Design balances -----
# (1) Air-flow balance drives W so perf.Fn matches Fn_des
W_bal = cycle.add_subsystem('W_bal', om.BalanceComp())
W_bal.add_balance('W', val=100.0, units='lbm/s',
                 lhs_name='Fn', rhs_name='Fn_des', eq_units='lbf')
cycle.connect('perf.Fn',           'W_bal.Fn')
cycle.connect('des_vars.Fn_des',   'W_bal.Fn_des')
cycle.connect('W_bal.W',           'fc.W')

# (2) Combustor-dh balance drives combustor.dh so Tt4 matches T4_des
T4_bal = cycle.add_subsystem('T4_bal', om.BalanceComp())
T4_bal.add_balance('dh', val=200.0, units='Btu/lbm',
                  lhs_name='Tt4', rhs_name='T4_des', eq_units='degR')
cycle.connect('comb.Fl_O:tot:T',   'T4_bal.Tt4')
cycle.connect('des_vars.T4_des',   'T4_bal.T4_des')
cycle.connect('T4_bal.dh',         'comb.dh')

# ----- Non-linear solver (Newton) on the cycle -----
cycle.linear_solver = om.DirectSolver()
cycle.nonlinear_solver = om.NewtonSolver()
cycle.nonlinear_solver.options['maxiter'] = 100
cycle.nonlinear_solver.options['solve_subsystems'] = True
cycle.nonlinear_solver.linesearch = om.ArmijoGoldsteinLS()"
